name: Kits
description: Sets of separate products that are cheaper together: a phone with a glass and a case, a fridge with installation. A kit is written for one product or placed by conditions (a category with its subtree, a characteristic), and a slot can be filled from a whole set of products — narrowed to what FITS the main product by a characteristic they share, so a glass for the model being looked at is offered without anybody maintaining a list of pairs. The discount is taken off the cart line itself, so 1C, a refund and a return all see what each item actually cost.
